issues.message: Check C1 command `pnpm test:e2e -- -g "exports a hierarchy tree"` fails with 'No tests found' (EXIT 1): pnpm forwards `--`, so Playwright treats `-g` as a file filter. The e2e itself passes when run as `pnpm exec playwright test --project=desktop --project=mobile -g "exports a hierarchy tree"` (2/2).
issues.recommendation: Fix the documented command in tasks.md (drop `--` or use `pnpm exec playwright test -g ...`); no implementation change needed.

findings.opportunity: ViewAsTree builds the fields array in checkbox-toggle order, so a user who unchecks and rechecks a field produces a non-canonical array such as ['fqn','kind','title']. nodeLabel then renders fields in array order, so text/Markdown lines become '[fqn] (kind) Title' instead of the documented fixed order '标题 [fqn] (kind)'.
findings.impact: Text and Markdown export lines become order-stable for any field-selection sequence, matching the documented fixed order and the snapshot contract.
evidence: generate-tree.ts: nodeLabel iterates fields in array order; resolveFields only substitutes ['title'] when empty
ViewAsTree.tsx: checkbox onChange re-adding a field moves it to the end
generate-tree.spec.ts: snapshots only exercise canonical order ['title','fqn','kind']
findings.recommendation: Canonicalize the selected field order inside resolveFields to the fixed ['title','fqn','kind'] sequence (filter the fixed order by membership).
findings.keyDesign: Add FIELD_ORDER = ['title','fqn','kind']; resolveFields = (fields.length === 0 ? ['title'] : fields) then FIELD_ORDER.filter(f => selected.includes(f)). nodeLabel keeps its switch. treeToJson untouched.
preservationConstraints: Line content for canonical field arrays (all current snapshots and e2e) must be byte-identical
Unselected fields never appear in text/Markdown lines
No duplicates introduced (filter by membership is idempotent)
implementationOutline: Rewrite resolveFields to filter the fixed order by membership
Keep nodeLabel and both renderers otherwise unchanged
Add a unit test asserting renderTreeText(roots, ['kind','title']) equals renderTreeText(roots, ['title','kind'])
validation: vitest run src/tree/generate-tree.spec.ts — existing snapshots unchanged plus the new order-insensitivity assertion
findings.priorityReason: Statically provable, user-reachable deviation from the documented fixed field order with a low-risk, behavior-preserving fix confined to the generators module and its unit tests.

findings.opportunity: elementFqn resolves fqn only from metadata.elementId or node.id, and ViewNodeLike omits modelRef/deploymentRef even though the real ComputedNode contract exposes both. Latent robustness/typing gap.
findings.impact: ViewNodeLike matches the ComputedNode identity contract; fqn is guaranteed to be the element or deployment identity with a documented precedence chain, at zero change to current output.
evidence: generate-tree.ts elementFqn = metadata.elementId ?? node.id; ViewNodeLike lacks modelRef/deploymentRef
ComputedNode declares modelRef?: aux.Fqn and deploymentRef?: aux.DeploymentFqn
element views set id === modelRef === fqn; deployment views set deploymentRef === id
findings.recommendation: Extend ViewNodeLike with modelRef?: string and deploymentRef?: string; resolve fqn as metadata.elementId ?? deploymentRef ?? modelRef ?? id (deploymentRef must precede modelRef).
findings.keyDesign: elementFqn = typeof metadata?.elementId === 'string' ? metadata.elementId : (node.deploymentRef ?? node.modelRef ?? node.id). JSDoc documents precedence: metadata.elementId > deploymentRef > modelRef > id.
preservationConstraints: Current fixtures/tests have no metadata.elementId and element-view node.id === modelRef -> output byte-identical
Deployment-view node.id === deploymentRef -> output byte-identical; deploymentRef before modelRef
Group/dynamic nodes carry no refs -> id fallback unchanged
No change to tree structure, sorting, or serializers
implementationOutline: Add modelRef?: string; deploymentRef?: string to ViewNodeLike
Update elementFqn to the metadata.elementId ?? deploymentRef ?? modelRef ?? id chain with JSDoc
Add a deployment-view unit test pinning deployment identity
Run generator unit tests and spa typecheck
validation: vitest run src/tree/generate-tree.spec.ts — existing snapshots unchanged plus deployment identity assertion
findings.priorityReason: Statically provable typing/robustness improvement confined to the generators module; byte-identical output; only remaining actionable.

findings.opportunity: The download always creates a Blob with type text/plain;charset=utf-8 regardless of format, so .tree.json files are served as plain text instead of application/json and .tree.md as plain text instead of text/markdown.
findings.impact: Downloaded JSON/Markdown files carry correct MIME metadata; filename and byte content unchanged.
evidence: ViewAsTree.tsx download(): Blob text/plain for all formats
findings.recommendation: Add a format-to-MIME mapping next to extensionFor and use it in the Blob constructor.
findings.keyDesign: const mimeFor = (format: TreeFormat) => format === 'json' ? 'application/json;charset=utf-8' : format === 'markdown' ? 'text/markdown;charset=utf-8' : 'text/plain;charset=utf-8'; download uses new Blob([content], { type: mimeFor(format) }).
preservationConstraints: Same file byte content and filename
No change to format/field selection or rendering
charset retained in every MIME value
implementationOutline: Use mimeFor(format) in the Blob constructor
validation: tree-export e2e download assertion retains filename and content
findings.priorityReason: Trivial, safe download-metadata fix with high confidence and no observable behavior delta.
